say: Every regression tool compares a page against yesterday's copy of itself — it catches what changed, never what only one kind of user sees.
That's a public practice site — nobody built it for Parallax. One U R L, one button… and seven contexts are opening on Cloud Run right now.
While it works: seven contexts on the same commit, each changing one property — role, language, theme, viewport. One disagreement, one cause. No stored screenshots.
Measure first. Model last.

Now the part no screenshot tool can do: the same game at two routes, pixel identical — one tells only the winner. Nobody is clicking these boards; Parallax plays them itself, and the ledger is what it observed.
Step seven. Identical winning line — amira is told she won; samir, that it is his turn.
And back to the sweep we started — the service remembers it, and while the game was being judged, it finished.
Invitation delivered to Samir — and correctly hidden from Amira. A negative expectation, checked live.
Every move must appear on the opponent's board before the next is allowed to run.
Now the winning move — watch Samir's board.
5 findings, produced while you watched. Now the evidence behind them.
Step seven fails. The winner is told… the loser never is. The engine wrote that verdict — not a caption.
Seven contexts side by side are too small to read, so any witness opens across the whole screen.
Any witness, full screen.
And a real call — audio truly travels here. One route mutes; the other only repaints the button.
Amira presses mute. Her control says mic off — and Samir still hears her. Omar hears nothing, but he chose silence, and is correctly not reported.
That distinction is the whole sensor.

The workflow ends where a developer's day starts. A real pull request, opened by the sweep — one failing Playwright spec per finding, one commit each. Eighteen of eighteen generated specs fail as assertions. None skipped, none passing.
One commit per finding.
All of it ran on one Cloud Run service, at its own Google address. Gemini, embeddings, Translation, Gemma — and this narration — one project.
Its own Google address — no trust required.
Seven applications declare their own defects, two clean controls among them. Seventeen of seventeen, zero false positives — graded in C I on every push. Parallax.
